title: GAN Adaptation for Network Data
summary: A single, no-README GitHub project that vendors the CTGAN synthetic-data library in-tree and runs a custom test script to adapt it for training on network-related tabular data. The repository copies the SDV-family CTGAN package wholesale and imports it directly with custom training monitoring, making SDV's CTGAN the core generative model being adapted.
evidence: CTGAN/network_ctgan_test.py:22-23 'from ctgan import CTGAN' / 'from ctgan.synthesizers.ctgan import CTGANSynthesizer' under '# Import CTGAN with custom training monitoring'
needs: No top-level README exists to confirm project purpose or domain (network traffic vs cybersecurity vs telecom); unclear whether the custom training monitoring actually runs training or only imports; vendored CTGAN directory appears to be an unmodified upstream copy.
